hints.title: Traverse and Collect Values
hints.text: Traverse the first tree to record all its numbers, then search for complements in the second tree.

hints.title: Complement Lookup via Ordered Search
hints.text: For each node value v in the first tree, check if target minus v exists in the second tree using standard logarithmic tree lookup.

hints.title: Terminate Early on Success
hints.text: Return true as soon as any valid complement is confirmed; otherwise return false after inspecting all candidate values.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N1: number of nodes in tree 1
N2: number of nodes in tree 2
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing every pair of nodes between both trees takes O(N1 * N2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing tree 1 values in a hash lookup allows O(1) checks during tree 2 traversal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should leverage either a lookup set or synchronized in-order two-pointer traversal.
complexity.notes: Standard set collection gives linear time complexity.
